1. System uses FastAPI backend with REST APIs.
2. PostgreSQL is the source of truth for transactional data.
3. Redis is used for cache/session acceleration where configured.
4. AI provider availability can vary; fallback provider may be used.
5. Voice input may include STT uncertainty; confidence is stored when available.
6. Financial projections are scenario-based (base, optimistic, pessimistic).
7. Google Sheets sync is optional and requires credentials.
8. Users are authenticated before accessing protected operations.
